title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Detectability-Aware Antidistillation of Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.23238v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distillation via reasoning traces exposes frontier models to adversarial third parties, who can bypass their guardrails and misappropriate their capabilities. Existing antidistillation defenses perturb the teacher's sampling distribution to hinder downstream student learning, but these perturbations also degrade the trace quality even when task accuracy is preserved, often leaving visible artifacts such as syntactic incoherencies and repetition chains. Beyond eroding user trust, such traces are statistically distinguishable, allowing adversaries to filter or resample them and weaken the defense. An effective defense must therefore limit how visibly it degrades the teacher. To address this gap, we formulate antidistillation as a max-min game whose constraint set explicitly encodes defense detectability. translated_title: 《藏于众目睽睽之下：推理模型的可检测性感知抗蒸馏方法》
translated_abstract: 通过推理轨迹进行蒸馏使前沿模型暴露于对抗性第三方，这些第三方能够绕过模型的防护机制并盗用其能力。现有的抗蒸馏防御方法通过扰动教师模型的采样分布来阻碍下游学生模型的学习，但即使任务准确率得以保留，这些扰动也会降低轨迹质量，常常留下明显的痕迹，例如句法不连贯和重复链条。除了削弱用户信任之外，这类轨迹在统计上是可以被区分出来的，使对手能够对其过滤或重新采样，从而削弱防御效果。因此，有效的防御必须限制其对教师模型造成的可见退化程度。为解决这一空白，我们将抗蒸馏形式化为一个极大极小博弈，其约束集显式地编码了防御的可检测性。同时满足这两个维度——在降低学生模型性能的同时保持不可检测——可能需要更巧妙的扰动，类似于隐写……
tldr: 该论文将抗蒸馏防御形式化为一个显式编码可检测性约束的极大极小博弈，使防御既能有效降低学生模型的蒸馏学习效果，又不会在教师模型的推理轨迹中留下可被对手检测和过滤的痕迹，从而实现隐蔽且鲁棒的抗蒸馏保护。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates antidistillation as a max-min game whose constraint set explicitly encodes defense detectability, enabling stealthy defenses that degrade student model distillation without leaving statistically detectable artifacts in the teacher's reasoning traces.
